captions.caption: A man in a blue beanie sits in a forest holding moss.
The man examines a bundle of dry moss in his hands.
He pulls apart the moss to show its texture.
The man speaks while holding the moss bundle.
He identifies the moss as "old man's beard".
The man continues to describe the moss's properties.
He looks at the camera while explaining the fire starter.
The man adjusts the moss bundle in his hands.
He points to the dry moss he is holding.
The man explains that the moss is very dry.
He pulls out a few strands of green moss.
The man shows different colors of moss in the bundle.
He continues to manipulate the moss while talking.
The man looks directly at the camera.
He points out the brown moss mixed with the green.
The man holds the moss bundle still while talking.
He rotates the moss to show all sides.
The man explains that getting a flame may take effort.
He gestures with the moss bundle.
The man continues his explanation about starting a fire.
He looks down at the moss in his hands.
The man mentions blowing on the moss to catch a flame.
He uses his free hand to gesture.
The man looks at the camera and prepares for the next step.
He lowers the moss and begins to explain the need for twigs.
The man gestures the size of thin twigs with his fingers.
He describes the twigs as being "pencil lead" size.
The man uses both hands to show a bundle of twigs.
He explains the twigs will go on top of the moss.
The man holds up the moss bundle once more.
He continues to talk about finding dry limbs.
The man looks around the surrounding forest.
He gestures towards the trees in the background.
The man explains where to find dead limbs on trees.
He continues his search strategy for dry wood.
The man looks at the camera and gestures.
He describes limbs that have been standing on the ground.
The man points to the side while talking.
He uses hand motions to describe dried-out twigs.
The man finishes his explanation of dry wood sources.
He looks at the camera one last time before moving.
The man begins to stand up and move away.
The camera pans down to the forest floor.
The view shows leaves and small branches on the ground.
The camera focuses on a fallen branch in the sun.
The fallen branch is shown with many dry twigs.
The camera moves closer to the upright twigs.
The dry twigs are highlighted by the sunlight.
The camera pans along the length of the branch.
The branch's thin twigs are clearly visible.
The man's hand reaches into the frame.
The man snaps off a small, dry twig.
He breaks another twig from the fallen limb.
The man continues to gather dry twigs.
He reaches for more twigs on the same branch.
The man snaps off several thin twigs at once.
He collects the twigs in his left hand.
The man continues to harvest twigs from the conifer limb.
He snaps off a final set of twigs from the branch.
The man examines the bundle of twigs he collected.
